column1: # SSE bytes per billed output token — the number that sets what one round retains, since the
# splice holds a round's events until it ends (Continuation needs the whole assistant turn).
# Raw byte counts straight from the gateway, output tokens from the stream's own message_delta.
# The ratio is mechanical, not fitted: ~4 bytes of text plus ~105 bytes of event framing per
# delta of ~3.5 tokens -> (14+105)/3.5 ~= 34. That is why it can be extrapolated to a
# max-length response: this gateway accepts max_tokens up to 128,000 (200,000 is refused with
# "the maximum allowed number of output tokens"), so a full-length round is ~4.5 MB.
